fieldInfo.description: LQA ETF Liquidity Limiting Holding Weight
fieldInfo.documentation:
Provides the weight of the security which has the greatest constraint in trading amongst the entire basket of underlying holdings in an Exchange Traded Fund (ETF).

This field is available as a premium product via Excel API and the Bloomberg BLPAPI. For more information about accessing LQA analytics, please contact your Bloomberg sales representative.

fieldInfo.description: Index Weighting Methodology
fieldInfo.documentation:
Funds:
Process the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) (or other Exchange Traded Product (ETP)) uses to weight the holdings of each security in the underlying portfolio based on predetermined criteria.

Possible selections include:

Dividend - Holdings are weighted based on their dividend yield.
Duration - Holdings are weighted by their duration characteristics.
Equal - Each security in the holdings is given the same weighting in the ETF.
Fundamentals - Holdings are weighted based on one or many fundamental factors. (i.e., Price/Book, Price/Earnings ratios)
Market Cap - Each security in the holdings is weighted according to its market capitalization. For fixed income funds it may also be based on size of debt outstanding.
Multi Factor - Holdings are weighted based on more than one specific characteristic.
Proprietary - Unique methodology used by the fund. May be undisclosed.
Single Asset- For ETFs that hold physical commodities. Also applies to Funds/ETPs that track the performance of a single underlying security, at par, leveraged, or inverse.
Price - Each security in the holdingsmakes up a fraction of the ETF, proportional to its trading price.

Indices:
Methodology for which underlying securities are assigned shares/weights within the index, i.e. price weight, capital weight, etc.

fieldInfo.description: Weighted Average Maturity Years
fieldInfo.documentation:
Funds: 
Provides the weighted average maturity in years for a fixed income Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) as calculated by Bloomberg's yield and spread analysis of the holdings. 

Index:
Average number of years to maturity of every issue in the index, weighted by market value.

fieldInfo.description: Average Weighted Coupon

fieldInfo.description: HB Women Board Members Percent Coverage Ratio
fieldInfo.documentation:
Provides the reported market value weight percentage of a fund covered by Holdings Based percent of board members that are women (FD648, HB_WOMEN_BOARD_MEMBERS_PERCENT).

Covered asset classes include equities, corporates, and preferreds.

fieldInfo.description: Holdings with Direct Exposure to Digital Assets

Provides the fund's constituent(s) and weight(s), as of the most recent fund holdings update that has direct exposure to crypto assets.

Exposure to crypto assets are defined under Digital Asset Indicator (DQ451, DIGITAL_ASSET_INDICATOR).
